deliveryModel: Outbound links only. Denny Games does not embed hosts or copy their builds, game data, or artwork.
verificationBoundary: All 43 listed play URLs returned HTTP 200 to direct GET by 2026-10-15. The prior browser spot checks and their individual exceptions remain recorded below. Twenty-six new pages from Libre Arcade, PVP, OpenGlad and Sheepdog Sim passed direct GET checks; OpenFront was excluded after its host returned HTTP 403 to automated GET. These checks establish reachability only, not a complete external game session, physical device, controller or Tesla browser behavior.
